description: We are a passionate team of young innovators who love science, technology, creativity, and space exploration. We believe in teamwork, curiosity, and turning ideas into meaningful solutions. By combining our different skills and perspectives, we aim to learn, create, and make a positive impact through innovation. We are excited to challenge ourselves, explore new possibilities, and be part of the global NASA Space Apps Challenge community.
